language.name: Message language
language.description: Language of the addon's chat messages and hints, independent of the game language. The settings page itself follows the game language.

whitelist.name: Trusted signers
whitelist.description: Names of genuine signers, comma separated. Default is AbgegrieftHD (official admin items). While the list is empty, no signature is checked.

threshold.name: Similarity threshold
threshold.description: Max edit distance for "possible fake" (0 = look-alike characters only)

icedOutCheck.name: Check Iced Out fakes
icedOutCheck.description: Warns about "Iced Out" items without an enchantment, because real ones always have one.

spawnEggCheck.name: Check mislabeled spawn eggs
spawnEggCheck.description: Warns when a spawn egg's name mentions a different mob than the egg really contains.

adminTextCheck.name: Check names and texts of admin items
adminTextCheck.description: Warns when name, text or layout do not match a genuine admin item (e.g. renamed item, code above the signature, admin text without genuine signature).

verifiedNote.name: Note on genuine items
verifiedNote.description: Shows a green tooltip line explaining why the addon considers an item genuine.

playerDetection.name: Mark other addon users
playerDetection.description: Shows a green mark next to players who also use the addon (tab list and name). For this the addon sends its version every 20 seconds through LabyMod to nearby players. When off, nothing is sent and nothing is shown.

reminderKey.name: Key (while hovering)
reminderKey.description: Press over an auction to set or remove a reminder

reminderHint.name: Suggest timer in tooltip
reminderHint.description: Shows on auctions which key sets a reminder

reportEnabled.name: Allow error reports
reportEnabled.description: Lets you report an item with a key (genuine item marked as fake, or fake not detected). Data is only sent after you choose in the chat. When off, the key does nothing.

reportKey.name: Key: report error (while hovering)
reportKey.description: Press over an item to start an error report

panelEnabled.name: Info panel in the auction house
panelEnabled.description: Shows the addon's keys, color legend, commands and status next to the auction house window.

panelSide.name: Panel side
panelSide.description: Side next to the window. If there is no room there, the panel switches to the other side automatically.

highlightBid.name: Color slots with your bid
highlightBid.description: Detected when you are the highest bidder or have set a bid limit

openDiscord.name: Help & ideas
openDiscord.description: Opens the support Discord for questions, bugs and ideas

warning.spawnEgg: WARNING - this egg contains a different mob (%s)
warning.chatSpawnEgg: %s: This egg contains a different mob (%s)

reminder.set: Reminder set: "%s" ends at %s, reminder at %s.
